tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the connected DCAST account: who it is (display name, public handle, the public address of its channel, brand), the plan, granted access scope and permissions, and how many videos and streams it has. tools.description: List videos in the connected DCAST account, newest first. Filter by processing status, visibility or a search phrase in title/description.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Get one video of the connected account: title, description, visibility, duration, resolution, status and playback links.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Upload and processing progress of a video (upload, transcoding, thumbnails) with an ETA when known.

tools.name: get_import_status
tools.description: Status of a video import started with import_video_from_url (queued, downloading, done, failed) and the created video id.

tools.name: get_video_embed_code
tools.description: Embed code and URL for a video. Rules (also in the answer as embedRules): Paste the code exactly as returned. tools.name: get_embed_domains
tools.description: The websites that are allowed to show this account's player and chat iframes. An empty list means every website is allowed. tools.name: list_streams
tools.description: List stream cards of the connected account with access mode (visibility), recording, live/offline state, viewers and playback links. Stream keys are hidden; use reveal_stream_key.

tools.name: get_stream
tools.description: One stream card: protocol, access mode (visibility), recording (whether broadcasts are kept as a recording), ingest server addresses (RTMP/SRT/WHIP), playback links, state. The stream key is hidden; use reveal_stream_key.

tools.name: get_stream_status
tools.description: Whether a stream is live, whether the encoder signal is arriving, current viewers and duration.

tools.name: reveal_stream_key
tools.description: Return the secret stream key and full ingest URLs of one stream, for configuring an encoder such as OBS. Only call when the user explicitly asks for the key. Anyone with the key can broadcast to the stream.

tools.name: get_account_analytics
tools.description: Views, storage use and content counts of the connected account over a period.

tools.name: get_storage_quota
tools.description: Storage used and the storage allowance of the connected account's DCAST plan, with the quota state (OK, NEAR_LIMIT, CRITICAL, EXCEEDED_GRACE, EXCEEDED_HARD). Use when the user asks how much space is left or why an upload or import was refused.

tools.name: list_restreams
tools.description: List restream setups that forward a DCAST stream to other platforms. Destination keys are not shown.

tools.name: import_video_from_url
tools.description: Create a video in the connected account by importing it from a public URL (direct file link). DCAST downloads, stores and transcodes it. Poll with get_import_status.

tools.name: create_video_upload
tools.description: Create a video card and a one-time upload URL; the bytes go with HTTP PUT to upload.url, not through this connector. If you can run commands where the file is, send them yourself (see Next); only if you cannot, use the upload button (data-dcast-upload) or import_video_from_url.

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Change the title, description, visibility, site placement (show_on_site) or paid access of a video in the connected account. tools.description: Create a stream card and get ingest server addresses for RTMP, SRT or WHIP (browser). A stream card has no planned start time: it goes on air when start_stream is called. Access modes as in

tools.name: set_embed_domains
tools.description: Replace the list of websites allowed to show this account's player and chat iframes, for example the company website so nobody else can embed the stream. This REPLACES the whole list: call get_embed_domains first and send the full list you want to keep. Entries: example.com, www.example.com or *.exa

tools.name: start_stream
tools.description: Press Start on a stream whose encoder is already sending: viewers get the multi-bitrate broadcast.

tools.name: end_stream
tools.description: Stop the live broadcast of a stream for viewers. The stream card stays and can be used again.

tools.name: create_restream
tools.description: Forward one of my DCAST streams to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Kick or custom RTMP; Instagram, TikTok, Kick and custom RTMP need rtmp_url (Instagram only rtmps://). Destination keys are sent to DCAST and are not echoed back.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete a video of the connected account with its files. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: delete_stream
tools.description: Delete a stream card of the connected account. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List the video rooms (meetings, webinars, broadcasts) of the connected account, newest first, with status, type, seats, join URL and planned start. Cancelled rooms are not listed.

tools.name: get_room
tools.description: One room: type, status, seats, recording and chat settings, planned start and end, and joinUrl (the page guests open).

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a video room and get joinUrl for guests. No start step: it goes LIVE by itself when the first person is in it through joinUrl (INSTANT, the default, starts LIVE). At joinUrl only DCAST accounts get in, via a waiting room the host admits from. Seats and recording follow the account plan; planA

tools.name: update_room
tools.description: Change a room: title, description, seats, recording, chat, screen share, guest video/audio, waiting room, raise-hand-opens-mic, planned start and end (null clears a planned time). Send only what changes. Seats and recording are reduced to what the plan allows (planAdjustments in the answer).

tools.name: start_room
tools.description: Usually not needed for people who join through joinUrl: a meeting starts on the first connection. It does not set LIVE.

tools.name: end_room
tools.description: End the meeting of a room for everyone in it. The room and its link stay; the next entry opens a new meeting. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: delete_room
tools.description: Delete a room. A room that holds recordings is cancelled instead and its recordings are kept: data.type is complete-deletion or soft-delete, read it before reporting. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: List the playlists of the connected account, most recently changed first, with title, visibility and item count.

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: One playlist with its items in order (videos and streams). The owner can read a private playlist too.

tools.name: create_playlist
tools.description: Create an empty playlist. is_public false keeps it visible to the owner only. site_section true shows it on the author's site as its own row. Add videos and streams with add_item_to_playlist.

tools.name: update_playlist
tools.description: Change the title, description (null clears it) or visibility of a playlist, or make it a row of the author's site (site_section, site_order). Send only what changes.

tools.name: add_item_to_playlist
tools.description: Append one item to the end of a playlist: send video_id or stream_id, exactly one. Both must belong to the connected account.

tools.name: remove_item_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove one item from a playlist; the video or stream itself stays. item_id is the video id, the stream id or the playlist item id.

tools.name: delete_playlist
tools.description: Delete a playlist. The videos and streams in it stay. Cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first.

tools.description: Status of an ask_site_access request by site code (delivered true = key issued to the site connector, which then writes it to the site environment: check its output), and the websites this connection gave access to.
